changelog.en: Added DLP Heater for supported DLP panels running floor heating: room temperature, active setpoint, mode and power are shown in Homey, and can be changed from Homey or Flows, including Flow cards to set the mode and setpoint, press a configured panel button, and a trigger when the thermostat mode changes. DLP panel buttons can also be pressed directly from Flows. The 12in1 multisensor relay outputs can now be controlled from Homey. Floor heating zones now show approximated power usage in Homey Energy.

hint.en: Confirmed transitions only. First read after restart is silent. Polling may delay detection. Mode tokens: 1 Normal, 2 Day, 3 Night, 4 Away, 5 Timer. Timer transitions are included.
hint.no: Bare bekreftede overganger. Første lesing etter restart er stille. Polling kan forsinke oppdagelsen. Modustokens: 1 Normal, 2 Dag, 3 Natt, 4 Borte, 5 Timer. Også overganger til Timer er med.

hint.en: Reads status only. Does not change power, mode or temperature.
hint.no: Leser bare status. Endrer ikke på/av, modus eller temperatur.

hint.en: Keeps the actual active mode. Reads, writes once and verifies the presets.
hint.no: Beholder faktisk aktiv modus. Leser, skriver én gang og kontrollerer setpunktene.

hint.en: Measured on DLP103. Test compatibility with other panels. Sends once; acknowledgement does not verify the programmed function.
hint.no: Målt på DLP103. Test kompatibilitet med andre paneler. Sender én gang; panelsvar bekrefter ikke sluttfunksjonen.
